new.issue: Teacher grid does not know Hop steps 3, 4 and 200
new.detail: Config lists steps 10, 5, 2 only and top 2, so a child on step 3, 4 or 200 shows wrongly and the new keys are not in any grid column.

new.issue: Teacher grid does not know Penguin Pairs level 5
new.detail: Config stops at level 4 with top 4, so level 5 has no name and may be flagged 'same level too long'. Near doubles are not in the hardest list.

new.issue: Bonds to 20 are invisible to the teacher grid
new.detail: bond20: keys are in no column; the about text still says the next beanstalk makes 100.

new.issue: Missing-leaf go arrives with no demonstration and the 10th is forced
new.detail: The leaf is pre-picked with no first-time tip; on the last go only two leaves remain so it is a 50-50.

new.issue: Redo after look-together can be copied
new.detail: The answer or sum was just shown, so Now you try can be done by copying. In Pipi and Hop the choices are reshuffled, in Beanstalk the frame already holds the partner.

new.issue: Look-together is long and can only be skipped after 3 seconds
new.detail: Runs up to 12 seconds; counting to 9 or 200 in Hop is slow and a child who already sees the answer must wait.

new.issue: Full help can last too long on each fact
new.detail: A new fact stays on full help until box 2 plus 2 quick days, and every new level or step starts at full help again, so a keen child may not be stretched.

new.issue: New question kinds arrive with no demonstration
new.detail: Near doubles at level 5 and the new fair pile start with no first-time tip.

new.issue: Counting back and from-3 starts arrive with no demonstration
new.detail: Back hops and non-multiple starts appear on gold days with no tip.
Four sums on one calendar mean each gets few days, and the sum is chosen by days not by what the child knows.

new.issue: Pipi finish screen praises ability and never says what is next
new.detail: Same 'Well done' and 'You are so good at this' whatever the accuracy; no signpost at level 3.

new.issue: Replays the same day can move the level or step
new.detail: Pipi, Penguin Pairs and Hop recompute the level on every finish, so replaying after a bad round can drop or lift it.

moves.why: Per-fact help ladder (full, faint, none) that returns after weak goes.
Why-lines and look-together for every wrong shell; none existed before.
Per-fact rows already existed; the teacher grid and alerts are new, but the first reviewer also leaned on a stricter reading of 'who is stuck'.
Times-itself distractors removed and a real fair pile; but part of the move is the second reader allowing 'one or two loopholes' at 3.
Level 5 added and the real pile; the top is still short, so a stricter reader might hold 2.
R5 why-lines and look-together, R9 pair-off hint.
Duplicates gone, target on screen, bridge; elimination remains but counts as one loophole under the rubric.
Why-line, frame and look-together replace the wobble.
The grid and alerts are new, but per-fact rows already existed in the first review, and 100 and 1000 still share one key each, so this is partly a different reading.
Endings tell removed; tap-all is now read as one loophole at 3 whereas the first review marked 2 partly for it.
Counting back, steps 3, 4 and 200; but the teacher grid lags and step still moves on replays.
Grid and alerts; per-fact rows existed already.
Not a move: the second review held it at 2 because the sum is calendar-only (the helper's 3 was argued down).
